title.narrative: EU4Environment - Governance and Regional Dialogue - Results 3 and 5

description.narrative: The EU4Environment Action aims to bring a higher level of environmental well-being for citizens in the Eastern Neighbourhood while also helping the six partner countries to grasp opportunities of greener economic growth and preserve their natural capital. The OECD will take responsibility for Results 3 and 5 that have the objective of promoting better environmental governance and ensuring faster policy diffusion regionally, coherence and coordination, and Action visibility.

EU4Environment generated explicit commitment by the Armenian and Moldovan authorities to carry reform of the compliance assurance systems especially the reform of the inspection systems and strengthening compliance promotion. This commitment was generated on the basis of environmental compliance assurance system reviews of Armenia and Moldova that were completed and published in English and in local languages. As with the reviews of Armenia and Moldova the Georgian enforcement authorities launched the process of reforming their inspection regimes following the development and discussion of the final draft of the environmental compliance assurance system review of Georgia. The draftreview was discussed during an online event with the government of Georgia and at the third regional environmental compliance assurance seminar in Brussels.NB The wording of this indicator is being reconsidered in order to better capture progress on the ground.
